attr.title: Copter
attr.desc: A fast-paced retro helicopter arcade game where you navigate your chopper through an endless cavern.
attr.desc_md:
Copter is a modern, feature-rich tribute to one of the most iconic browser games of the early internet era. This project is a lovingly crafted clone of the classic Flash game "Helicopter Game," originally released in 2002 by creators David McCandless and Leandro Barreto.

Navigate your chopper through an endless, procedurally generated cavern. Hold the button to ascend, release to descend, and avoid crashing into the jagged walls or floating obstacles for as long as possible. While the core one-button gameplay remains true to the addictively simple original, this version has been completely rebuilt from the ground up for modern retro handhelds.
attr.inst: Ready to run, no additional files needed.
